rows.note: Use 學生 as the all-purpose term for a schoolchild or pupil.

example.english: Every schoolchild in our class lives quite far away.
example.traditional: 我哋班每個學生都住得好遠。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 baan1 mui5 go3 hok6 saang1 dou1 zyu6 dak1 hou2 jyun5

rows.note: Use 學生仔 when you specifically mean a young school pupil rather than a student of any age.

example.english: That schoolchild goes to play football as soon as school lets out every day.
example.traditional: 嗰個學生仔成日放學就去踢波。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 hok6 saang1 zai2 seng4 jat6 fong3 hok6 zau6 heoi3 tek3 bo1
